# Psychotria regression inputs

Unmodified copies of the bundled BioGeoBEARS tutorial tree and geography in
`r_package/RustBEARS/inst/extdata`, retained under the repository's GPL terms and
original BioGeoBEARS attribution to Nicholas J. Matzke. They exercise a real
19-tip profile-cache rebase regression in tests of the installed Python wheel.
They are not new geographic observations or a statistical calibration dataset.
